# Opening cinematic art provenance

These five 1672 × 941 opening proof shots were generated using OpenAI's built-in image generation tool from existing project artwork as visual references, then converted to WebP at quality 90 without cropping or composition edits. They were created as narrative bridge shots for the opening, not as canonical puzzle diagrams. Source references were inspected visually; no claim is made that AI-only output necessarily creates copyright or grants rights held by others. See the repository content license for its scope.

- `kaelan-loupe-v1.webp`: generated October 28, 2026, using `15A_Kaelan.webp`, `13_ Crystal Array.webp`, and `generated/ceremony-opening-v1.webp` as identity, crystal, and setting references.
- `crystal-fracture-v1.webp`: generated October 28, 2026, using the crystal array and ceremony imagery; no puzzle diagram was intentionally rendered.
- `plaza-aftermath-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using ceremony and array imagery and the Kaelan bridge shot.
- `thalor-address-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using `15D_Lord Thalor.webp`, the ceremony, and crystal array as identity and setting references.
- `ceremony-shard-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using ceremony, array, and `generated/crystalshop-opening-v1.webp` as material and setting references; the shard is shown at the plaza, not an invented handling event.

Generated imagery is illustrative, not a precise representation of the game's branching-ring puzzle geometry. The canonical comparison should be drawn deterministically from game source. The images were visually reviewed; Thalor reads stern rather than smiling, and the shard extends slightly into the lower caption area.

The first-person inspector scene uses `inspector-at-the-door.webp`, generated with OpenAI image generation using the existing crystal shop opening illustration as a reference and converted to WebP. It depicts the inspector delivering the grading notice to Kaelan’s father.

The companion shots `condemned-tag.webp` and `disposal-barge.webp` were generated with the same tool, using the existing shop and night canal illustrations as references, respectively. The close-up shows Kaelan turning the shipment tag. The canal shot shows the rejected cargo passing the dock.

The interactive light bench uses a photographic background plate and separate transparent lamp, brass cradle and quartz layers generated with OpenAI image generation. The shop opening and condemned tag stills supplied the visual references. The approved specimen used the feathered specimen as its reference. The game draws the moving shadow and streaks at runtime. The light bench study is a frame captured from the playable scene.

The walkable shop uses eight WebP textures generated with OpenAI image generation. `shop-survey-wall` and `shop-entry-wall` depict the two end walls. `shop-study-wall` depicts the notebook wall. `shop-field-notes` and `shop-runner` dress the journal and woven rug. `shop-canal-view` supplies the distant scenery beyond the window. `shop-walnut` and `shop-limewash` supply surface detail for the modeled interior. A small reflection map samples the four room views. The engine lights the modeled furniture, brasswork, and specimens, with the playable quartz artwork supplying the visible inclusions.

`shop-interior-study.webp` is a frame captured from the walkable shop during playtesting.

The canal seen through the playable window uses `shop-canal-panorama.webp`, generated with OpenAI image generation using the earlier canal view as a reference. The panoramic texture wraps around the shop, with water below the sill and sky above the transom.

Episode 3 uses `night-quay-panorama.webp` and `barge-overlook.webp`, generated with OpenAI image generation using the disposal barge shot as a reference. The daytime shop panorama also supplied the spherical projection reference. The lower-steps sighting reuses the disposal barge shot. The game draws the same optical features over both views and the movable tracing sheet. `quay-flagstones.webp` and `quay-sketchboard.webp` are generated surface and prop textures. The planking and ballast textures are crops of the disposal barge image.

Episodes 4–24 use eleven spherical environment paintings and twenty-one photographic finding plates in `season/`, generated with OpenAI image generation. The archive key, workshop covering, and water basin have additional close-ups. Each finding plate was cropped from an episode-specific panel in a four-shot sheet. The game renders the foreground apparatus, placements and optical overlays at runtime.

The standing cast and furnishings use original, transparent photographic cutouts generated for this build. Mira, Kai, Thalor, and the Order leader use the existing character portraits as visual references. The walkable floor textures are projections of each environment, and the portable specimen and its plinth have separate visibility layers.
